subject: physics
content:
Match List I with List II.

List - I List - II
(A) Coefficient of viscosity (I)
(B) Intensity of wave (II)
(C) Pressure gradient (III)
(D) Compressibility (IV)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
explanation:
Here are the dimensional formulas:

Coefficient of viscosity, μ

Intensity of a wave, I

Pressure gradient, dP/dx

Compressibility, κ

Matching gives

(A)–(IV), (B)–(I), (C)–(II), (D)–(III), i.e. Option C.
